candidate_evidence.quote: This is a single-center, open-label, dose-range finding Phase I study of hP1A8, a new adjuvant CD200 activation receptor ligand (CD200AR-L), in combination with imiquimod and the GBM6-AD vaccine to treat recurrent glioblastoma (GBM) in adults.
Maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of hP1A8 when administered with imiquimod and GBM6-AD

candidate_flag.reason: hP1A8 is described as a vaccine adjuvant (immune agonist peptide) given with a tumour lysate vaccine; whether it counts as a pharmacological candidate or as part of the excluded vaccine intervention needs adjudication.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Radiographically or histologically proven progression or recurrence of disease at any time after standard of care therapy (radiation, temozolomide, with or without a tumor treatment field device).

role_evidence.quote: Up to 3 dose levels of hP1A8 will be tested with a Dose Level -1 in the event of toxicity.

coder_notes: Only hP1A8 is a registered intervention; imiquimod and the GBM6-AD vaccine are not registered interventions but every patient receives them per the summary and primary outcome, so they are listed. The dose-finding question concerns hP1A8 only, so imiquimod (given to all, not dose-varied) coded soc_backbone per C3; it could alternatively be seen as a co-investigational adjuvant. If hP1A8 is judged part of the vaccine intervention, the trial would have no candidate (excluded_intervention_type).
